item.title: Elon Musk posted 82 times on X today (11/15/26)
item.description:
On November 15, 2026, Elon Musk posted 82 times on X, and this daily recap from Jacob & Isaac walks through them by topic. The headline is SpaceX's first Starship tower catch on Flight 15, when Ship 42 returned to Starbase and was caught by the chopsticks, even as the Super Heavy booster ran low on fuel and was lost. The rest of the episode covers Starlink capacity, Grok Bot and Grok updates, SpaceX AI infrastructure, Nvidia after Jensen Huang, U.S. politics, and a few miscellaneous posts.
